03.12.2025 Order No.
05. 1. This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/ Physical Mode).
2. Heard the learned counsel for the Petitioner-Informant as well as learned counsel for the State-Opposite Party No.1.
Perused the application as well as the prayer made therein.

3. Learned counsel for the State, on the basis of the instruction from the IIC, Ranpur dated 17.10.2025, stated before this Court that the present IIC after taking over charge on 13.04.2025 found that the wearing apparels/biological sample was not sent to S.F.S.L., Bhubaneswar for chemical examination.
It is also been stated that the F.I.R. named accused persons were not arrested in connection with this case.

The report further reveals that on examination of the complainant-victim girl by the present I.O., it was ascertained that the victim girl and her family members did not cooperate with the I.O. during the investigation of the case and that they did not want to proceed further in this case.

4. On perusal of the record, it appears that the occurrence took place on 27.12.2016 whereupon the Informant, who was aged about 19 years then, lodged the F.I.R. before the Ranpur P.S. for commission of offences under Sections 366/506/354-A(III)/376/342 of the IPC.

In view of the aforesaid position, this Court is of the view that investigation agency has seriously neglected the investigation.
Moreover, it appears that the concerned Magistrate has also shown the slackness in pursuing the matter judiciously.
In view of the aforesaid position, the Court direct the registry to call for a report from the District Judge, Nayagarh with regard to the progress of the trial in the present case.

Simultaneously, a report be called for from the Superintendent of Police,
Nayagrh calling for an explanation as to why there was a delay in the investigation as has been reflected in the report dated 17.10.2025.
6.
List this matter in the week commencing 5th January, 2025.
